messages:
mike_cs: FYI — customer acme-1234 reporting a big discrepancy at month cut. Dashboard shows 78.2k tokens for Feb cutoff but invoice shows 112.9k. They're on Pro-Plus annual. Can billing triage?

megan-billing: Thanks Mike. Can you paste account id + invoice id and any routes they spike on?

mike_cs: Account: acme-1234, invoice: INV-2028-02-334. Primary workload: chat generation + nightly batched embeddings. Customer attached screenshots of dashboard vs invoice.

lina-support: Seen the screenshot — invoice has an extra line labeled `batch-embed` for ~34.7k tokens that doesn't appear on dashboard totals.

ashley-eng: Quick thought — did the meter-run at month cut include late ingestion from the nightly embed worker? Historically we had a mix of cutoff semantics (some legacy accounts use local tz vs global UTC) which can cause a month "bucket flip".

devon-infra: I'll pull the ledger around the cutoff window. Running a narrow query now: 

```sql
SELECT timestamp, route, tokens
FROM meter_events
WHERE account_id='acme-1234' AND timestamp >= '2028-02-28T23:00:00Z' AND timestamp <= '2028-03-01T01:00:00Z'
ORDER BY timestamp;
```

ashley-eng: Also check for backfill retries — retries can backfill ingestion timestamps or generate new events if idempotency keys are missing.

devon-infra: Pulled logs. Found a batch-embed worker that finished at 2028-03-01T00:20:12+01:00 (customer tz). Our invoice meter-run executed at 2028-03-01T00:05:00Z. Those tokens were ingested/processed slightly after cutoff but have ingestion timestamps that put them into the previous window due to backfill logic. That explains the ~34.7k.

megan-billing: So invoice included late backfills; dashboard snapshot didn't. Was anything double-counted?

devon-infra: No duplicate event IDs, so not double-counted. The discrepancy is due to different snapshot semantics: dashboard pulls cached snapshot (last refreshed at 23:59Z) while the billing job aggregates based on ingestion timestamps which were backfilled by the worker. In short: late backfills landed in invoice window but dashboard cache missed them.

lina-support: Customer is confused because they can see no corresponding events in the UI. Dashboard's cache refresh interval (15m) + snapshot time meant those rows weren't visible.

megan-billing: Proposed remediation: 1) explain root cause to customer (late backfill crossing month boundary). 2) offer a one-off credit for the 34.7k tokens while engineering patches the flow. 3) engineering fixes: normalize ingestion timestamp behavior for backfills or have meter-run prefer processing_time for month boundaries.

ashley-eng: I'll open infra ticket to change backfill semantics and add a safe-guard for month boundaries (TKT-4521). Also propose an alert when month-end meter delta > 10% vs dashboard snapshot.

devon-infra: Estimated effort: 3-5 days to implement change + small rollout. I'll attach the ledger export and the meter query results to the ticket.

mike_cs: Customer asking for formal note + ETA. Megan — can you confirm credit and wording to share?

megan-billing: I'll draft the customer message and run the credit through approvals. Draft will say: "We identified late embed backfills that were included in the invoice but not in the dashboard snapshot. We will issue a one-time credit of 34,700 tokens and adjust internal backfill logic to prevent recurrence. ETA for engineering fix: ~1 week rollout."

billing-bot: Ticket created: TKT-4521. Assignees: devon-infra, ashley-eng.

mike_cs: Thanks all — looping customer in and will post the draft. :thumbsup:
